package repro

// Unrelated declarations are removable noise.
type Metadata struct { Label string }

func unrelated(value int) int {
    if value > 0 { return value + 1 }
    return 0
}

// This is Go string data, not a suppression comment.
const example = "// cyclo-allow(fn_params): documentation example"
func Plain() int { return 1 }

func anotherUnrelated() string {
    return "noise"
}
